Dichotic stems from Greek dicha apart and ot- ear via German dichotisch. The o may belong to the ear element; semantically and historically the Greek in-two family is related, but a nonoverlapping exact dicho- prefix is not established. No new synthetic stem is asserted. Dictionary.com confirms dicho- becomes dich- before vowels; this is a same-family lookup, not a claim that the o belongs uniquely to the prefix.
